title: MEIKO — Training For A Dream♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for showing us that video of you and your team competing in Shinobi Battle, Haruka♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That was so cool!
Even though I knew I was watching a video, I couldn't help but cheer for you guys.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know how you feel! I did the exact same thing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: From the first person to the very last, this competition felt like a continuous highlight reel.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No, wait!
He's clinging to the bottom of the log!

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<Wait, he's stopped all of a sudden!
Is something wrong?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: He was doing so well. What happened?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's hard to see from this video, but the strap for his left foot broke.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, we had no idea.
The announcer didn't really say what had happened while we were streaming.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I mean, why didn't they call a timeout?!
It seems really unfair for him to lose time because of an equipment malfunction!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't watch! This part always makes my heart jitter!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't worry! She'll find a way out of this!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. They all cheered their lungs out♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We weren't able to win, but I think we did as well as we did because you helped me come up with those training schedules.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Again, MEIKO, I can't thank you enough.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But that was such an exciting competition. Now I feel like exercising and stuff too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know how you feel!
The variety-show star in me can't keep herself still!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's wonderful!
I wish there were something we could do to work off some of that energy...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Actually, I think I have just what you all need.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The equipment you use during checkups and stuff! Like this one, you use it to measure your grip strength!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And this one is for doing... Umm... Seated forward bends?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've even got a tape measure, a stopwatch and data sheets!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO said she wanted to run a fitness exam after you girls held that training camp. So, she asked me to gather everything we'd need.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And now we finally can!
Thank you, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Fitness exams?
That does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I bet I'll do great at that thing where you hop from side to side!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Are you talking about side steps?
I'm also pretty good at those!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Things are getting heated already♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, why don't we all participate?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO, you made that look so easy.
I don't think anyone's going to beat your score.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think Airi has a slight lead!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Create momentum by swinging your arms as hard as you can. One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? Shizuku...?
You just seem to be doing squats at this point...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She isn't sure when to jump...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I think I'm done...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Nice work, KAITO.
Why don't we rest over here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka and MEIKO are still going strong.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Darn it. I used too much energy during the side step test.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So...
Do we have a winner?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, I'll announce our overall winner.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's gotta be Haruka or MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They both did very well during every test.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO and Haruka! It's a tie!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I knew that we were neck and neck all throughout, but I didn't think it'd end in a tie like this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Me neither. I'm just as surprised.
I thought that I'd do well, but not this well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think it's because of the exercises you suggested that we do as part of our training, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think we have a nice rivalry on our hands now♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'm going to win it all next time we do this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not so fast. I have to do well again to make sure everyone knows that today's result wasn't just a fluke.
